name: PRO-cad2 Workbench
description: The workbench of the mechanical and parametric design programs, in the Pro skin: a dark title bar, one command bar of named tool groups with the full set under each group, the browser tree over Properties on the left, document tabs, a navigation bar under the model, an edit palette by the pointer and a status bar. The same chrome, sizes and icon colour in every app.
author: CadCraft
